units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|The mountain air tastes cool and fresh after breathing the constantly recycled air on the <ship> for so long, so you take a moment to get a good lungful and enjoy the view. Just off to your right, ground technicians wearing thin coveralls and breathing gear are spraying some kind of chemical on the hull of a parked Sunder. The fine mist reflects a bright rainbow which contrasts strikingly with the dull gray metal of the hull.|1064|0

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	You wander over, careful not to get too close to the spray, which you assume is toxic. units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"It's confirmed. Shipworm. Bad case, too - I'm surprised your hull was still holding atmosphere." He looks back at the Sunder, measuring it up with his eyes. units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"As a model Syndicate employee," he says sardonically, "I can tell you that the rumors that the shipworm is indigenous to this planet are untrue, and that the miners are categorically not hauling them out of the ground along with the ore. In fact, if you even use the term 'Delvan shipworm' there is a good chance that you'll have Syndicate lawyers suing you for defamation."|1088|0
